name: Trigger Scheduled Event
description: Fire a scheduled event now, ahead of its time. A one-shot event is removed; a recurring one stays scheduled at its unchanged next fire time. It needs schedule/manage on the event (<account>/x/schedule/<id>). Returns the fired operation's result as a call to it would: an agent:request gives its task if the agent has not answered within the request's timeout, and at once when an agent triggers a request to itself.

handle.description: Handle of the event to fire now

triggered.description: True if the event was fired

result.description: Result produced by the fired operation, if any
